The Meaning of Dussehra

Vijayadashami — the tenth day of victory, after nine nights of Navaratri.

🔱

Durga defeats Mahishasura

For nine days and nights the Goddess fought the buffalo demon Mahishasura, whom no god could defeat. On the tenth day she slew him — the victory of Shakti over arrogance.

🏹

Rama defeats Ravana

Lord Rama, after worshipping Durga, defeated the ten-headed Ravana and rescued Sita. That's why effigies of Ravana burn tonight — evil never wins in the end.

🌿

Shami & Ayudha Puja

The Pandavas retrieved their weapons from the Shami tree on this day. We worship our tools, exchange Shami leaves as "gold", and begin new things — learning, work, life.

Nuvvunte Chaalu… 💛

Nuvvu navvithe, nenu navvutha 😊
Nuvvu edisthe, nenu edustha 🥺
Nuvvu alisipothe, nenu nee needa avutha 🌙
Nuvvu gelisthe, nenu chappatlu kodutha 👏
Nuvvu bhayapadithe, nenu nee dhairyam avutha 🦁

If you laugh, I laugh. If you cry, I cry.
If you're tired, I'll be your shade. If you win, I'll cheer the loudest.
If you're scared, I'll be your courage. If you're quiet, I'll sit right beside you.
I don't need the whole world, Tejamma — nuvvunte chaalu. ❤️
